operational_list_selector_key.description: the selector for an active situation list, a UTC history day list, or its copy state

operational_list_entry_key.description: the situation or notice slug, UTC day, or reserved copy marker within an operational list

operational_list_entry_json.description: a JSON-encoded operational list entry of at most 4 KiB, including an empty-day marker when needed

operational_list_entry_version.description: the version marker of the operational list entry layout

operational_list_bucket_key.description: the active_situations, all_situations, or recent_notices key of a legacy operational list

operational_list_payload_json.description: the JSON-encoded contents of one legacy operational list

operational_list_updated_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a legacy operational list was last updated

notice_history_day_key.description: the notice_history_day prefix followed by the UTC date of a notice history bucket

notice_history_event_order_key.description: the zero-padded Unix creation time and notice slug joined by # within one notice history day

notice_history_entry_json.description: a JSON-encoded notice history entry of at most 4 KiB

notice_history_entry_version.description: the version marker of the notice history entry layout

notice_event_slug.description: the stable slug of an operational notice event

notice_event_kind.description: the upgrade, restart, deploy, config, cutover, or other kind of an operational notice

notice_event_title.description: the one-line title of an operational notice event

notice_event_summary.description: the plain-text summary of an operational notice event

notice_event_occurred_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when the event in an operational notice occurred

operational_scope_system_names.description: the system names within the scope of an operational situation or notice

operational_scope_app_ids.description: the app identifiers within the scope of an operational notice

notice_actor_identifier.description: the person, agent, or routine identifier responsible for the event in an operational notice

operational_situation_slug.description: the stable slug of an operational situation

notice_severity_hint.description: the info or warn severity hint of an operational notice

notice_event_expires_at_text.description: the RFC 3339 expiration instant as text, or an empty value for a notice without expiration

notice_record_created_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when an operational notice record was created

related_work_card_slugs.description: the work card slugs related to an operational situation or notice

related_knowledge_record_slugs.description: the knowledge record slugs related to an operational situation or notice

operational_situation_title.description: the one-line title of an operational situation

operational_situation_summary.description: the plain-text summary of the current operational situation

operational_situation_status.description: the active, monitoring, resolved, or archived lifecycle status of an operational situation

operational_situation_severity.description: the p0, p1, p2, or p3 severity of an operational situation

operational_scope_repository_names.description: the repository names within the scope of an operational situation

operational_scope_routine_names.description: the routine names within the scope of an operational situation

operational_scope_automation_ids.description: the automation identifiers within the scope of an operational situation

operational_current_phase_id.description: the identifier of the current phase of an operational situation

operational_phase_list_json.description: a JSON-encoded list of operational phases and their scoped action rules

operational_blocked_action_names.description: the action names prohibited by an operational situation

operational_allowed_action_names.description: the action names explicitly allowed by an operational situation

operational_approval_required_action_nam.description: the action names that require operator approval under an operational situation

operational_preflight_message.description: the message presented to an agent when an operational preflight rule matches

operational_situation_owner_identifier.description: the person or agent identifier responsible for an operational situation

operational_situation_created_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when an operational situation was created

operational_situation_updated_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when an operational situation was last updated

operational_situation_expires_at_text.description: the RFC 3339 expiration instant as text, or an empty value for an operational situation without expiration

operational_snapshot_id.description: the stable identifier of an operational posture and notice snapshot

snapshot_captured_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a metadata snapshot was captured

operational_posture_count_decimal_text.description: the base-10 text encoding of the count of active postures in one snapshot

notice_event_count_decimal_text.description: the base-10 text encoding of the count of notice events in one snapshot

operational_posture_summary_list_json.description: a JSON-encoded list of short active operational posture summaries

notice_event_summary_list_json.description: a JSON-encoded list of short operational notice event summaries

operational_snapshot_schema_hashes_json.description: a JSON-encoded map of the schema identities used by an operational snapshot

operational_blocked_action_list_json.description: a JSON-encoded list of prohibited action names in a short operational posture summary

operational_posture_summary_captured_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a short operational posture summary was captured

notice_scope_system_names_csv.description: the comma-separated system names in a short operational notice summary

notice_summary_captured_at.description: the RFC 3339 instant when a short operational notice summary was captured
